_mode: new = combine_new.py, the guide chain (2026-10-23). old = this file's chain below. Per run: COMBINE_WAY=old.
_comment: Processing applied to every converted (RVC) vocal before it is mixed with the instrumental, by combine_stage.py. 'chain' runs top to bottom (serial compression per mastering.com/vocal-compression-how-to-compress-vocals), then the loudness match, then a master limiter on the mix. Edit values here; no code change needed. Skip all of it with pipeline.py --no-vocal-fx.

chain._what: tame S sounds (4-7 kHz) brought up by the presence/air boosts
final EQ: gentle high-shelf cut at the end of the chain (2026-10-21, made standard after the Janice STFU v2 test)

loudness._what: Default (no per-song boost given): gain the vocal after the chain so its loudness matches the ORIGINAL vocal stem, plus offset_db, clamped to max_boost_db. A per-song boost (Hankify 'Vocal boost (dB)' box, pipeline.py --vocal-boost-db, or vocalboost re-mix) replaces this with that exact number.

reverb._what: Short-tail vocal reverb. ON BY DEFAULT since 2026-10-07 (user: 'until i find a song where it ruins things') at default_percent; per-song off = --vocal-reverb 0 (Hankify: untick 'Add vocal reverb'; vocalboost --no-reverb); per-song amount = --vocal-reverb PCT. IR = decaying stereo pink noise.

master_loudness._what: Final two-pass EBU R128 loudnorm of the whole mix (user 2026-10-08: YouTube standard). Opt out per run: combine_stage --no-loudnorm. linear=true keeps dynamics when the target is reachable within the true-peak ceiling.

rider._what: Fader riding before the chain. ON by default: engine "waves" = the real Waves Vocal Rider (Mono) run headless via ~/.local/share/vocal-rider-host (falls back to the native vocal_rider.py if it fails); engine "native" = vocal_rider.py only. Skip per run with combine_stage --no-vocal-rider.
